text:
devrel-jo: Heads-up: we just shipped the Community Contrib Toolbelt v0.1.0 :sparkles: — focused on lowering the barrier for first-time contributors (templates, lightweight QA, and a tiny guided PR flow). Release: https://github.com/redwood/contrib-toolbelt/releases/tag/v0.1.0
devrel-jo: Why it exists: a few folks reported onboarding took too long. This bundle includes issue templates, a reproducible local sandbox, and a short "first PR" walkthrough that walks someone from clone -> green CI in ~15 minutes.
ci-bot: CI: Release artifacts published and tag `v0.1.0` created for redwood/contrib-toolbelt — all checks green 
security-sam: awesome. can we add an optional pre-merge token-scan step? we can wire in the org scanner as a github action
devrel-jo: @security-sam yes — there's an example workflow under .github/workflows/security-scan.yaml. the action is opt-in by default.
nora: small UX note: the sandbox uses test-org/test-repo creds by default, may confuse folks. suggest we add a short warning in README and a one-liner to reset sandbox state.
ops-ash: nice work. is there any infra cost/cleanup we should be aware of for sandbox environments?
devrel-jo: sandbox runs ephemeral containers on the dev cluster and auto-prunes after 2 hours. for heavy usage we can bump quotas, but current defaults are free-tier friendly.
ci-bot: Quick snippet added to the release notes for local dev:
```
# quick start
git clone https://github.com/redwood/contrib-toolbelt.git
cd contrib-toolbelt
pnpm install
pnpm run sandbox:start
# open http://localhost:3000 and follow "Get started"
```
devrel-jo: Office hours tomorrow 11:30am PT in #devrel-qa to demo the guided PR flow and run a live contributor onboarding. bring a laptop if you want to try the flow. :laptop:
security-sam: i'll join and walk through the security gating options + a lightweight checklist you can enable per-repo.
nora: i'll post a short blurb to the community newsletter and schedule a maintainer onboarding session for next Wed.
ops-ash: leaving a note for infra: if the community increases sandbox churn we should look at autoscale rules. filing infra-ticket INF-4721.
devrel-jo: Thanks all — big thanks to external contributors @alice-r and @contrib-bot for testing the guided flow. We'll track follow-up items as issues tagged `toolbelt-feedback`. If you find small nits, please open a 1-line PR. :rocket:
